description:
Pinpoint the status of one component by name (case-insensitive
    substring match). Returns an error listing the candidates when the
    name matches several components. The response has the service's
    Pingoru page (pingoru_url) and, when the component is in an open
    incident, that incident with its own page.
    Slug accepts shorthand / typos via fuzzy fallback.
name: component_status
title: Check one component
